label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: A Jehová de ejércitos, a él santifiquen ustedes; y él temor de ustedes, y él terror de ustedes.
spanish: A Jehová de ejércitos, a él santifiquen ustedes; y él, temor de ustedes, y él, terror de ustedes.
grammarChanges: Added commas around the two appositive pronoun clauses ('y él, temor de ustedes' / 'y él, terror de ustedes') for readability; wording and word order unchanged.
Confirmed 'él' as the accented personal pronoun (he), not the article 'el'; no change needed there.
Left 'terror' as rendered per freeze; did not act on Grok's participle-smoothing warning, since that would require an interpretive rewrite.
